equations.description: Formula for the center of mass of n plus 1 blocks, based on the center of mass of n blocks and the position of the n plus 1th block. The formula is N times C sub N plus 1 times C sub N plus 1, all divided by N plus 1, where C sub N is the center of mass of the first N blocks.
A recursive formula for the center of mass of n plus 1 blocks, where C sub N plus 1 equals C sub N plus 1 over N plus 1.
The center of mass for the first block is 1.
The center of mass for two blocks, C sub 2, is equal to 1 plus 1 half.
The center of mass for three blocks, C sub 3, is equal to C sub 2 plus 1 third, which simplifies to 1 plus 1 half plus 1 third.
The center of mass for N blocks, C sub N, is equal to the sum of the reciprocals from 1 to N: 1 plus 1 half plus 1 third plus 1 fourth plus an ellipsis plus 1 over N.
The center of mass for N blocks, C sub N, is equal to S sub N, the sum of the harmonic series.

Inequality relating the natural logarithm of N to S sub N, where the natural logarithm of N is less than S sub N, which is less than the natural logarithm of N plus 1. This shows the harmonic series diverges. The expression is enclosed in a red box.
As N approaches infinity, the natural logarithm of N approaches infinity.
S sub N approaches infinity.
Thirteen blocks equal twenty-six units.
Twenty-six minus two equals twenty-four.
The natural logarithm of N equals 24. This expression is enclosed in a white box.
N equals E to the 24th power.
3 centimeters times E to the 24th power is approximately equal to 8 times 10 to the 8th meters.
The geometric series 1 plus X plus X squared plus X cubed plus an ellipsis equals 1 over 1 minus X.
The absolute value of X is less than 1, which is the condition for the geometric series to converge.
The sum of the infinite series 1 plus X plus X squared plus an ellipsis is equal to S.
The sum of the infinite series X plus X squared plus X cubed plus an ellipsis is equal to S times X.
One is equal to S minus S times X.
S minus S times X is equal to S times the quantity 1 minus X.
1 over 1 minus X is equal to S.
Infinity minus infinity equals infinity minus infinity.

A general power series is represented as a sum of terms A sub 0 plus A sub 1 times X plus A sub 2 times X squared plus A sub 3 times X cubed plus an ellipsis, which equals the summation from N equals 0 to infinity of A sub N times X to the power of N.
The absolute value of X is less than R, indicating the radius of convergence where the power series converges.
The interval of convergence for X, where X is greater than negative R and less than R.
The sum of A sub N times X to the power of N diverges when the absolute value of X is greater than R.
The absolute value of A sub N times X to the N power approaches 0 exponentially fast when the absolute value of X is less than R.
The absolute value of A sub N times X to the N power does not approach 0 when the absolute value of X is greater than R.

The derivative with respect to X of the power series (A sub 0 plus A sub 1 times X plus A sub 2 times X squared plus A sub 3 times X cubed plus an ellipsis) is equal to A sub 1 plus 2 times A sub 2 times X plus 3 times A sub 3 times X squared plus an ellipsis.

equations.description: The integral of the power series (A sub 0 plus A sub 1 times X plus A sub 2 times X squared plus an ellipsis) with respect to X is equal to a constant C plus A sub 0 times X plus A sub 1 times X squared over 2 plus A sub 2 times X cubed over 3 plus an ellipsis.

Taylor's formula states that a function f(x) is equal to the summation from n equals 0 to infinity of the nth derivative of f evaluated at 0, divided by n factorial, multiplied by x to the power of n.
The nth derivative of f evaluated at 0.
The exponential function E to the X is equal to the summation from N equals 0 to infinity of 1 over N factorial, multiplied by X to the N power.

Euler's number e is equal to e to the first power, which is equal to 1 plus 1 plus 1 over 2 factorial plus 1 over 3 factorial plus 1 over 4 factorial plus 1 over 5 factorial plus an ellipsis. The terms 1 plus 1 correspond to n equals 0 and n equals 1, respectively.
The sine function, sine X, is equal to X minus X cubed over 3 factorial plus X to the 5th power over 5 factorial minus X to the 7th power over 7 factorial plus an ellipsis.
The cosine function, cosine X, is equal to 1 minus X squared over 2 factorial plus X to the 4th power over 4 factorial minus X to the 6th power over 6 factorial plus an ellipsis.
